Odoo is still where your records live: Your customer list, stock and billing stay in Odoo. We keep the guide for every kitchen, at prices you update in our admin platform, along with every order placed through our app.

Kitchens on the Odoo shop can stay on it: If some accounts already use Order Again in your Odoo shop, leave them be. Save our app for the accounts whose chefs still reach for the phone to order. A call to your office gets no number from us; every order spoken in our app is numbered.
Billing stays with Odoo: Quotes, invoices and any online payment you take remain in Odoo and its customer portal. We take the kitchen's order; the bill still comes from Odoo.

step.text: A spreadsheet from Odoo is usually all we need: the items each customer takes and the price, under your codes.

step.text: We load the guides and open the accounts; the kitchen downloads the app. Most place a first order the same day.

@graph.name: Would an Odoo alternative fix the phone orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Another ERP would still get the same calls, because they come from chefs who would rather not sign in and type. Give those accounts our app to say what they need, and keep every other part of Odoo as it is.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Odoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only at one job: collecting what a kitchen ran short of today, spoken by the chef and checked before it reaches you. Outside that, Odoo does far more, so we run next to it.

@graph.name: Odoo already lets customers reorder. Why add this?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does. An invitation-only shop shows each customer its own pricelist, and Order Again in the portal copies an older order into the cart. Both mean signing in first, then searching or editing quantities. Ours begins with whatever the chef notices is missing today.

@graph.name: Are there voice ordering tools for Odoo already?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add-ons in Odoo's app store can have an AI answer a customer's phone call and build the sale, and other tools read emailed orders. On a call to a phone bot, there is no list on screen to look over while ordering. In our app, the chef sees every line and fixes it before sending.

@graph.name: Are Odoo and VoiceOrder Solutions linked?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Neither product comes with a link to the other, and each of the two companies supports only its own software. Orders that come through EDI or the API can land in Odoo without anyone typing them again, if your Odoo is set up to accept them that way; we confirm that in the demo. An order that goes by email shows up as an attached file the chef has already gone over, and someone on your team keys it in from that rather than from a call or a voicemail.

@graph.name: Do we have to install anything in Odoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not to get started. Our setup asks for no access to your Odoo account and adds no module: we start from a file you pull out of Odoo. If, later on, you would like orders to arrive over EDI or the API, we walk through what your side would need during the demo.

@graph.name: How long does it take, and how does pricing compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Going live takes 24 to 48 hours for most distributors. Odoo puts its prices on its website; we do not, and quote per distributor instead. Moving to an Odoo alternative means a full Odoo replacement: every app, record and habit at once. Adding us leaves all of them where they are.
